com.vector.cfg.model.groovy.api

Interface IModelApiEntryPoint

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IMdfModelApi, IMicrosarQuery

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IModelApiEntryPoint
extends IMdfModelApi
    IModelApiEntryPoint is the entry point for MDF model read access. The MDF model access API is the entry point for convenient AUTOSAR model access for read and write. It also provides a generic API to the MDF data model.
